description: Policy for scripts/hooks/ledger-presence-guard.js. Soft rollout during the first 14 days from sprint SP-20260519-001 release — flips to block after smoke validation per SP-20260514-002 routing-trace precedent.
notes: lookback_window_ms = how far back to scan recent events.jsonl rows when correlating a watched-command invocation to a ledger.write. 60s covers typical sprint command durations. anchor_missing_severity=loud_warn — if the target file lacks the section anchor entirely, the guard emits a stronger warn than the standard 'missing row' warn (per SP-20260519-001 redteam threat 'anchor marker removal as silent opt-out').
